cohort: 9144 women who gave birth between 2009 and 2016 at a tertiary hospital in The Netherlands
finding: Intrapartum maternal hemoglobin level was not associated with the risk of fetal distress or adverse neonatal outcome but was associated with mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Instrumental vaginal delivery for fetal distress was related to a higher intrapartum Hb level, whereas cesarean section for nonprogressive labor was related to a lower intrapartum Hb level.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a factor influencing intrapartum Hb level
